message: Hi Alex, it's Dev at Polar HVAC, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Dev, honest answer: I used an AI tool to draft it, then edited and sent it myself. I also use AI for site audits, but I review everything before it goes out. I'm Alex, I run a small shop fixing website issues (not apps or ads or SEO). Happy to show you what I found on Polar HVAC's site if you want a quick look.
